title: Successful 2-Factor Authentication
objective: Verify complete login sequence with valid password and valid TOTP code
expected: CHALLENGE OTP_REQUIRED followed by OK AUTHENTICATED (role: analyst)

title: Failed Password Verification
objective: Verify server rejects incorrect password with generic error and decrements attempts
notes: Uniform timing preserved; remaining attempts accurately tracked.

title: Failed TOTP Verification
objective: Verify server rejects incorrect 6-digit TOTP code after valid password verification
notes: Rejection does not expose internal verification state.

title: Unauthorized Access Rejection
objective: Verify protected command (PCAP_ANALYZE) is rejected when unauthenticated
notes: Protected server diagnostic commands cannot be accessed anonymously.

title: Role-Based Access Control Enforcement
objective: Verify authenticated user with 'analyst' role is blocked from admin-only 'DIAG' command
expected: ERROR FORBIDDEN ("Role 'analyst' is not permitted to run DIAG.")

actual.message: Role 'analyst' is not permitted to run DIAG.

notes: Principle of Least Privilege enforced on administrative endpoints.

title: Open Port Detection (8765 & 8888)
objective: Verify bounded TCP port scanner identifies active test services on 8765 and 8888
notes: Reachable ports identified via 3-way handshake completion.

title: Closed Port Detection
objective: Verify bounded TCP scanner correctly reports closed state for inactive port
notes: TCP RST received from operating system kernel.

title: HTTP Baseline Configuration Inspection
objective: Verify HTTP checker flags missing CSP, missing nosniff, cookie insecurity, and Server header
expected: Flags missing security headers, missing cookie attributes, and Server disclosure
notes: Identifies baseline hardening gaps without false exploit claims.

title: HTTP Connection Failure Handling
objective: Verify HTTP checker gracefully handles connection refused without unhandled exceptions
notes: Graceful timeout and connection error containment verified.

title: Server-Side PCAP Analysis & Threat Detection
objective: Verify server loads PCAP, computes summary, and detects vertical scan, SSH burst, and UDP/53 anomaly
expected: 123 packets parsed; detects Vertical Scan (192.0.2.50), SSH SYN burst (192.0.2.60), and DNS anomaly (192.0.2.20)

detections: Repeated SYN burst to single service

notes: Server Scapy rdpcap() extracted all 6 suspicious activity indicators.

title: Malformed Frame & Schema Validation
objective: Verify server rejects invalid JSON frames and unexpected fields with structured errors
notes: Framing and JSON decoders enforce strict boundaries and schema validation.

title: TOTP Token Anti-Replay Enforcement
objective: Verify identical TOTP token cannot be reused across multiple sessions within same 30s window
expected: Session 1: OK AUTHENTICATED; Session 2 (Replay): ERROR AUTH_FAILED
notes: last_otp_counter atomically checked; replay blocked and audited.

title: Clean Client-Server Disconnection
objective: Verify EXIT command returns BYE GOODBYE and gracefully terminates the TCP session
expected: BYE GOODBYE status received and socket closed
notes: TCP connection shutdown cleanly without lingering half-open state.

title: Audit Log Credential Sanitization
objective: Inspect sentinel_audit.log to verify zero passwords, raw tokens, or secrets were written
expected: No plaintext passwords, raw OTPs, or secret keys in log records
notes: Strict RedactingFilter and redaction helpers sanitize all security event logs.
